name: life-tracker
description: Life Tracker - Track expenses, splits, recurring bills, and reminders

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r index.html manifest.json sw.js privacy.html oauth-native.html icons js life-tracker-logo.png dist/
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:copy: npm run build && npx cap copy android
scripts.build:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd ..
